anical Couplings YUM A DESALTING PLANT PRESSURE VESSELS AND GROOVED MECHANICAL COUPLING COMPONENTS P art 1 Background The Bureau of Reclamation’s (Reclamation) Yuma Desalting Plant (YDP) is 73-million Gallon per day rated brackish water desalination facility utilizing Reverse Osmosis (RO) technology. When the facility was designed in the 1980’s the market for RO membrane elements had yet to converge on a standard element size, and the plant was designed to operate with 12-inch (in) and 8.5-in diameter elements. Since that time the market has converged on standard sizes of 8-in and 4-in diameter elements. This has resulted in limited availability of 12-in and 8.5-in elements. To increase the number of potential membrane element suppliers Reclamation has decided to retrofit the YDP with 8-in diameter pressure vessels (PV). The YDP originally had 720 of the 8.5-in diameter PVs installed. Due to the availability of 8-in membrane elements with the same active membrane area as the 8.5-in, the 8.5-in PVs will be replaced with 8-in PVs on a one-to-one basis, which have already been purchased. To continue the retrofit for this section, Reclamation requires the purchase of 720 grooved mechanical couplings, and new gaskets for the couplings on hand. The grooved mechanical couplings have

The Contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, equipment, vehicles, transportation, fuel, materials, supplies, permits, and other resources necessary to perform the services described in this statement of work (SOW) and each authorized Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) call. Services may include: - Routine grading of existing gravel roads - Snow plowing of Refuge roads, access roads, and parking lots; - Wing plowing to move accumulated snow away from roadways and shoulders; and - Application of salt and/or sand at the headquarters parking lot and maintenance shop area.
